sources.entry: Traq - Project management and issue tracking system written in PHP. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Traq is a PHP-based project manager and issue tracker that handles issues across multiple projects and milestones.
summary.what_it_does: Traq is a web application written in PHP for tracking issues across multiple projects, with support for multiple milestones per project. The README describes it as a project manager capable of issue tracking. It requires PHP 8.3+ and MariaDB or MySQL, and uses Apache mod_rewrite (or an equivalent server setup that routes 404s to index.php). Installation is done by uploading the files to a server, opening the URL in a browser, and following the on-screen steps. Building from source uses Composer for PHP dependencies and pnpm to install Node packages and build the UI. The README names Avalon and Nanite as bundled components under LGPL v3.
use_cases: track bugs and issues for software projects
self-host an issue tracker on a web server
lightweight project management on PHP hosting
how_to_run: Rename htaccess.txt to .htaccess (or configure an equivalent rewrite rule)
Open the URL in a browser and follow the installation steps
notable: Multiple projects, each with multiple milestones
Self-hosted PHP web application with a browser-based installer
Build pipeline combines Composer and pnpm for the UI
caveats: Requires PHP 8.3 or newer and a MariaDB or MySQL database
Needs Apache mod_rewrite or a server configured to route missing paths to index.php
Building from source requires both Composer and Node/pnpm toolchains
